claim: The GOG release starts and is playable with no Steam client and no GOG Galaxy client running.
evidence: The owner launched the installed GOG copy (F-ENV-009) with Steam and GOG Galaxy closed and reported that it starts and plays (in chat, 2026-10-27).
verification_method: Owner's manual launch test on the dev machine, reported in chat. Not observed or automated by Claude Code (no game process is started by the project).
limitations: A single manual test by the owner on one machine; online features (which the project never touches, rule 3) were not part of it. The second player's copy is not yet checked.
next_experiment: D-008 (owner decision). The second player's copy gets the same read-only check.
